name: Azithromycin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Community-acquired pneumonia (mild); pharyngitis (second line); uncomplicated skin infection
usual_adult_dose.dose: 500 mg on day 1, then 250 mg daily on days 2 to 5
500 mg day 1 then 250 mg days 2–5, or 500 mg daily for 3 days

key_interactions.action: No dose change; watch for liver and hearing effects.

serious: QT prolongation and torsades de pointes

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to azithromycin, erythromycin, any macrolide or ketolide
History of cholestatic jaundice or hepatic dysfunction with azithromycin
monitoring: QT and electrolytes when at risk

pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 6% unchanged in urine over a week
